### Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

|---|---|---|---|---|

### Country-specific policy context

<div class="country-policy-context">Program is not considering Point-of-Care G6PD testing since there are so few vivax cases - too much investment for little impact. In the new guidelines being approved this year, the guideline are updated to 7-day low dose PQ (0.5mg/kg/day).</div>
